# Results

Here we can compare our sampled observations against the true funciton, the results are shown in @fig-obvs.

```{python}
#| label: fig-obvs
#| fig-cap: "Showing the sampled observations against truth"
#| fig-pos: H
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from extra_utils import get_files
indir = Path(exp_name + "/Data")
data = get_files(indir,['x','y','x_grid','f'])
plt.plot(data['x_grid'],data['f'],'r-',label='Truth')
plt.plot(data['x'],data['y'],'kx',label='Observations')
plt.xlabel('$x$')
plt.ylabel('Observations $y$')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```
